title: How deep light reaches, and why estimates from chlorophyll differ
query: The depth of the sunlit (euphotic) layer is often estimated from chlorophyll, but published relations give different depths, and it matters whether surface chlorophyll or the whole profile is used. Using the supplied CMEMS global biogeochemical reanalysis monthly chlorophyll and nitrate for 1993-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), estimate the euphotic depth in several defensible ways, quantify how far the estimates differ by season and region, and determine which choices account for most of the difference. Show whether the differences change a conclusion that depends on that depth, such as whether the nitracline lies inside the sunlit layer. Irradiance is not supplied.
